artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan closing the S4 world bound (birth-key S4LoopInv redesign, exponent fix, pigeonhole) plus a decision-gated Phase 9 decidability phase with standing BLOCKED permission

memory_candidates.content: When a loop-checking termination bound needs pairwise distinctness of worlds as a per-step invariant, but the underlying per-world data (relevant formula set) grows monotonically as the branch grows, live-set equality is NOT a valid loop invariant: a later persistent step can fill the coordinate two worlds differed on, collapsing them. The fix is to key each world on STABLE birth data that never changes after the world is born, state the invariant as (a) the birth key is a monotone lower bound on the live set and (b) birth keys are pairwise distinct, and make the minting guard block on the prospective successor's birth content rather than the source world's set. Distinctness of immutable keys is trivially preserved by every later step; the pigeonhole then injects worlds into the finite powerset of signed subformulas. Codomain size for a sign-distinguishing relevant-set notion is 2^(2|Sf|), not 2^|Sf|.
